title: Senior AI Engineer - Machine Vision
description:
Senior AI Engineer

£782/day (Inside IR35) | 12-Month Contract | London (2 Days Onsite)

Overview

The Clinical Platforms team is seeking a Senior AI Engineer to help develop and deploy advanced AI solutions that power large-scale medical imaging initiatives across the business.

This is a highly technical engineering role sitting at the intersection of Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Computer Vision and Cloud Engineering. You'll be responsible for building, deploying and maintaining production-grade AI systems that enable researchers and scientists to extract value from complex imaging datasets and AI-driven workflows.

The team is looking for a hands-on engineer with strong Python, Machine Learning and Google Cloud Platform (GCP) experience who can take ownership of AI solutions from design through to production.

What You'll Be Doing
  • Designing, developing and deploying AI-powered applications and machine learning systems
  • Building and maintaining infrastructure supporting AI, machine learning and computer vision workloads
  • Creating end-to-end AI pipelines covering data preparation, model training, evaluation and deployment
  • Working with large-scale medical imaging datasets in cloud environments
  • Deploying, monitoring and optimising production AI models and services
  • Developing AI solutions for complex imaging and clinical research use cases
  • Monitoring, troubleshooting and improving the performance of production AI systems
  • Collaborating with engineers, researchers and data scientists across multiple projects
Key Skills & ExperienceEssential
  • Strong commercial experience with Python development
  • Experience building and deploying AI or Machine Learning solutions into production
  • Strong Google Cloud Platform (GCP) experience
  • Experience designing and delivering production-grade AI platforms and systems
  • Strong understanding of systems architecture and cloud infrastructure
  • Experience building end-to-end AI and machine learning solutions
  • Proven track record delivering engineering and AI projects into production
Highly Desirable
  • Computer Vision or Image Processing experience
  • Exposure to Machine Learning platforms and MLOps environments
  • Experience working with image datasets at scale
  • PyTorch, OpenCV, NumPy or related technologies
  • BigQuery and wider GCP ecosystem experience
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor, Claude Code or GitHub Copilot
Nice to Have
  • Medical imaging experience
  • DICOM or PACS exposure
  • Healthcare, biotech or pharmaceutical industry experience
Ideal Background

We're open to candidates from a variety of backgrounds, including:

  • Senior AI Engineers
  • Machine Learning Engineers
  • Computer Vision Engineers
  • AI Platform Engineers
  • Applied AI Engineers
  • Research Engineers
  • Software Engineers with strong AI, Cloud and Machine Learning experience

The key requirement is strong, hands-on commercial AI engineering experience and the ability to design, build and support complex production systems.

Why Join?
  • Work on cutting-edge AI and medical imaging initiatives
  • Contribute to platforms supporting drug discovery and clinical research
  • Opportunity to work across AI Engineering, Machine Learning and Computer Vision projects
  • Long-term 12-month contract with strong extension potential
Contract Details
  • Role: Senior AI Engineer
  • Contract Length: 12 Months
  • Rate: Up to £782/day
  • IR35 Status: Inside IR35
  • Location: London
  • Working Pattern: 2 Days Onsite Per Week

If your background sits across AI Engineering, Machine Learning, Computer Vision and Cloud Platforms, I'd be happy to share further details.
